newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hino sees poor 1997/98 local truck demand.
newsitem.headline: Hino sees poor 1997/98 local truck demand.

text.p: Hino Motors Ltd said on Tuesday it expected domestic demand for heavy trucks to total 142,000 units in the business year starting from April 1, down from an estimated 151,000 in 1996/97.
The expected drop was due to the impact of a planned increase in Japan's consumption tax to five percent from the present three percent, effective from April 1, a Hino spokesman said.

The Japan's top heavy truck maker also said the change between the business years would be exaggerated slightly because it expects heavy truck sales to go up in the January-March period ahead of the consumption tax rise.
Hino is owned 11 percent by Toyota Motor Corp.
